steps.content: Since you got here, the doorbell has barely rung. Angell has her own keys, so she never needs to use it.
You have a bad feeling. As the doorbell rings again and again, you look through the peephole to see who's outside.
Through the peephole, you see a man wearing a baseball cap at the door, you can't make out his face but his malice is palpable, even the case in his hand seems dangerous.
Alarm sets off in your head. Should you pretend no one's home, or just say you don't recognize him? Either way, you can't open this door, otherwise...

steps.speaker: Stranger
steps.content: Heh, your breathing gives you away.
A sharp, loud crash explodes beside your ear! A huge axe narrowly misses your face as it carves a groove into the thick metal door.
You instantly back away as the man keeps hacking at the door with his axe relentlessly. Meanwhile, a mechanical arm emerges from his case and reaches through the gap on the door, searching around.
But as soon as it touches the doorknob, it's yanked away by a tremendous force!

The cold voice sends shivers down your spine as you comply and step back immediately. Then, a long blade thrusts through and slices down the metal door, the grating sound of metal being cut through and the thug's screams fill the air.
...You recognize this blade. Angell's back, and she's about to use that blade to take that man's life.
